programme.desc: Heracles was a modest mid-table team in the First Division in the early 1970s. Major defeats are the rule rather than the exception. On a wet December day at the end of 1974, this suddenly changed when the great Ajax was eliminated 4-2 in the KNVB cup tournament. Players like Hannes Lalopua, Warry Grobben, Jan Bronkers and goalkeeper Arend Steunenberg are suddenly heroes and still think back every day to one of the most legendary matches in Heracles' club history. – Heracles was a modest mid-table team in the First Division in the early 1970s. programme.title: UEFA Europa League archive: Odense – Wisła Kraków 01/12/2011 – 2011/2012 season
programme.desc: episode. In the program, viewers will see fragments of memorable matches played in the UEFA Europa League. From the 2009/2010 season, this competition replaced the previous UEFA Cup. The authors pay special attention to matches involving Polish clubs. The first Polish team to win the right to play in the LE group stage was Lech Poznań, later Wisła Kraków and Legia Warszawa also achieved this feat. The greatest success so far was promotion to the 1/16 finals of Lech in the 2010/2011 season, Legia and Wisła in the 2011/2012 season and Legia Warszawa in the 2014/2015 season

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: A plane crash occurs in the middle of the Arctic tundra. The only passenger on the plane is Overgard (Mads Mikkelsen), who manages to escape unscathed. At first, he believes that help will come soon and he persistently maintains some semblance of communication with the world by broadcasting a radio message about his situation. One day, hope for rescue appears when Overgard sees the outline of a helicopter on the horizon. However, it crashes into the ice. A girl found in the wreck motivates him to act. Feeling responsible for the stranger, despite the extreme conditions and numerous frostbites, the man decides to travel to a distant research station. The main character is played by the winner of the Palme d'Or for the 2012 film The Hunt... Iceland. 2018. adventure drama

programme.title: Primates – Protecting primates | E03
programme.desc: A documentary series devoted to our favorite primates, presenting species that are rarely shown on screen. Modern technology has enabled creators to capture their world from a unique perspective and in their natural environment, whether it is the treetops of a flood forest or the dense bushes shrouded in the darkness of a Sri Lankan night. Over the course of two years, the filmmakers undertook twenty-eight expeditions around the world, braving snowstorms in the Moroccan Atlas Mountains and wading through flooded jungles in remote corners of Sumatra and Brazil. They were among the first in history to immortalize the newly discovered Tapanuli orangutan species and were the first in years to attempt to film a white uakari. One team spent over two months in Equatorial Guinea, camping on a remote beach to record the most intimate scenes from the life of a mandrill, one of the least understood primates in the world. In Sri Lanka, thanks to low-light technology, the first color images of mysterious gray loris in the wild were captured at night. Captivating animal stories combine real family drama with cutting-edge science. A seemingly terrifying silver-backed mountain gorilla encountered on the volcanic slopes of the Congo turns out to be a gentle and caring father to its young. According to the latest research, it is caring fathers who achieve the greatest reproductive success. Viewers will also see South Africa's elusive pygmy galago, part of a recently discovered urban population, as it raids the local zoo at night. In Malaysia, they will learn about the world of treetops from the perspective of white-handed gibbons, shown on screen for the first time in history. The unique series is narrated by naturalist Chris Packham. It seems that we know our relatives from the animal world well, but nothing could be further from the truth. The diversity of primate species is enormous - from giant gorillas to lithe lemurs. They inhabit various regions of the world and ecosystems. USA, Great Britain. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Big Brother Oasis | E02
programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. It was created in a reserve in Tanzania, an area of ​​the African savannah with poor water resources. It is not only an excellent vantage point for hidden cameras, but also a place of respite for wild animals such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. During the hottest season of the year, thirsty animals come to water only in the evening and at night. It is cooler during this time. However, water-hungry creatures must be careful because they may encounter hyenas under the cover of darkness. Great Britain, USA. 2020. nature series

programme.title: 30 for 30: You Don't Know Bo
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: In this series, archaeologists are deciphering the mysteries surrounding the personality of Tutankhamun, the most famous pharaoh of Ancient Egypt. We will witness the opening of the sarcophagus of Tutankhamun in his tomb, which has been sought for thousands of years. New technologies make it possible to understand why this tomb of the young pharaoh could not be found for so long, and it turned out to be unplundered by countless looters. programme.title: d/s Veterinarian from the outback. Birth of puppies
programme.desc: Dr. Liu tries to save Rainbow the French bulldog from the effects of a snake bite. Dr. Rick and his team track down a wild camel. And Ed and Duncan free the lemon shark Lina. Australia, 2019

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian from the outback. Cyclone over the clinic
programme.desc: Cyclone Damien, the most powerful to hit Karratha in a decade, is heading towards a veterinary hospital. Meanwhile, a woman plans to cross Australia on a camel. Australia, 2019

programme.title: d/f Fukushima: nature in the disaster zone
programme.desc: After the Fukushima disaster, many areas became dangerous for life, but some animals continue to exist in these conditions. Experts are sent to the disaster zone to study their adaptation to the toxic environment. This film will tell about how animals survive in a polluted area, and about what happens to nature after those terrible events. Dir.: Richard Max. Cast: Adam Hart. UK, 2021

programme.title: d/f Wild horses of France
programme.desc: A documentary about the wild horses that live in the Camargue nature reserve in France, which is the crown jewel of European wildlife. In this picturesque location, located between two tributaries of the Rhone that flow into the Mediterranean Sea, you can observe the life of these majestic animals throughout all seasons of the year. The film reveals the beauty and uniqueness of these horses, as well as the peculiarities of their existence in a breathtaking natural environment. USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Return of the disappeared. No Man's Land
programme.desc: The series is about how nature restores balance after human intervention. The story of how Amur tigers, beavers, leopards and other species that were on the verge of extinction began to thrive again. The restoration of ecosystems and the return of extinct species is the result of the joint efforts of scientists, environmental organizations and people who care about preserving our planet. South Korea, 2023

programme.title: d/s Wild China. 1 p.
programme.desc: Guilin's fairytale hills and cormorant fishermen on the Li River form the basis of this journey through the colorful rice crops and strange creatures of Southern China. 2018

programme.title: d/s Survival strategy. Secret War: Courtship Period
programme.desc: Showcasing the incredible and sometimes mind-boggling strategies that different species of organisms have used over the past four billion years to produce offspring in the battle for survival. Director: Park Seung-woon. South Korea, 2017

programme.title: d/s Symbols of wild nature. Giants are vegetarians
programme.desc: Their multi-ton frames shake the earth as they cross the plateau of Africa. Luckily, these massive animals are herbivores and lead mostly solitary, peaceful lives. France, 2014

programme.title: d/s Wild Thailand. Hunter game
programme.desc: In the cloudy rainforests, fertile wetlands and bustling cities of Thailand, wild animals engage in an eternal battle to the death to find prey or to avoid becoming dinner. Their survival depends on intelligence, cunning and ingenuity. 2014

programme.title: d/f Mavindo. The Great Drama of the Serengeti
programme.desc: In the vastness of Africa's Serengeti National Park, animals face constant threats. For them, every day is a struggle for survival, where danger can come at any moment. In the savannah they must be alert to avoid becoming victims of predators or poachers. This film will reveal the exciting and challenging world of the wild, where every moment matters for survival. Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain, 2019

programme.title: t/s Wild killers. Stealth
programme.desc: In the wild it is survival of the fittest, and each creature has its own set of skills and weapons. Viewers will get to know poisonous spiders, fast snakes, camouflaged cuttlefish, ferocious sharks and other deadly animals. This exciting journey will reveal the secrets of the hunters at the top of the food chain. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA, 2023

programme.title: d/f Italy. In places of wild nature. Ravine: Grand Canyon of Italy
programme.desc: This episode features the nest of a pair of endangered redshanks, a pack of wolves living in a gorge, an otter fishing in the Bradano River, and many species of amphibians found only in Italy. 2023

programme.title: d/s Water World of Komodo Island. Mysterious cave and sunken ship
programme.desc: Explore Komodo Island, a unique ecosystem that will take you back 100 million years. You will see huge Komodo dragons, a variety of sharks and rays, sea turtles and dolphins. Hidden in the sunken cave is the mystery of Ebu-gogo, a mysterious creature that scientists still cannot solve. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Germany, 2021

programme.title: d/f Jackals of the Namibian coast
programme.desc: The documentary takes viewers into the world of the endangered black-backed jackal, which has taken refuge on Namibia's Skeleton Coast. In this harsh and uninhabited region, jackals are forced to adapt to new conditions and learn to interact with each other in order to successfully hunt and obtain food. The film reveals the complex process of their adaptation, hunting and survival in this unique and dangerous corner of the planet.

programme.title: d/s Wild Thailand. Game of procreation
programme.desc: The need to reproduce drives all life in the wild of Thailand. Birds, elephants and monkeys alike go to extremes in search of the perfect partner. But finding a match is only the first step. Raising children requires dedication and hard work. 2014

programme.title: d/s Azure Monastery. 4 s.
programme.desc: The bay is an embrace of life, as well as a spawning ground, a hatchling area, and a feeding ground for many marine life. Each species that calls the bay must have a unique survival strategy. 2021

programme.title: d/s Quick attacks in the wild. Fast and desperate
programme.desc: Discover how predators attack their prey. In South Africa, where great whites use explosive hunting techniques to catch fur seals, polar bears can be seen using speed to catch walruses on Arctic ice floes. Australia, 2022

programme.title: d/f Cayman and the damned swamp
programme.desc: Interesting and tragic stories sometimes happen in nature. The young caiman needs water, but its level is quite low. Now, in order to survive, he needs to adapt to the new reality. But the Pantanal swamps hide various dangers. He will have to fight for his life almost every day

programme.title: d/s History of the reef. Reef Rivals
programme.desc: A small corner of the Red Sea is home to one of the most stunning coral reefs on the planet. But this underwater kingdom has more than one ruler. 2018

programme.title: d/s Wildlife of Singapore. River World
programme.desc: Take an exciting journey through Singapore's rivers and waterways to learn about the rich flora and fauna that live there. Singapore, 2020

programme.title: d/f Wild Slovenia
programme.desc: Slovenia is a country full of natural contrasts. We will visit the majestic Alpine peaks, the hidden forests of the Dinaric Mountains, as well as the Pannonian plains and karst caves. Let's dive into the underground world and enjoy the views of the Adriatic Sea. More than 50 species of animals are tracked throughout the year, showing different stages of their life cycle and environmental influences

programme.title: d/f Magic Forest of Spain
programme.desc: 80 kilometers from Madrid, in the heart of Spain, lies a magical corner shrouded in old forest. Here, in one of the most fertile ecosystems on the planet, life is in full swing. We will meet eagles, ferrets, eagle owls, badgers and other amazing animals of this forest. 2019

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. The most dangerous on land

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. The cutest
programme.desc: Adorable kangaroos, plush koalas, cheerful clown fish, elegant budgies. Which one is the cutest? USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s The last inhabitants of the reefs. The last inhabitants of the reefs

This project will tell about the life of coral reefs, their inhabitants and the unique ecosystems that they support. You will witness incredible stories of survival, struggle for territory and adaptation of sea creatures. 2018

programme.title: d/f Dragons from Komodo Island. Love story
programme.desc: The remote archipelago off the coast of Indonesia is home to the majestic Komodo dragons, the largest lizards in the world. Their life is a daily struggle for survival. There is always not enough water and food, and fierce battles break out for each female, in which several adult males participate at once. France, 2018

programme.title: d/f Green Belt of Europe
programme.desc: The Iron Curtain once divided Europe, creating a neutral zone with barbed wire, patrols and strict borders. However, this strip of land, while remaining virtually untouched by humans, has become a haven for wildlife. Today, the area along the former curtain is known as the European Green Belt, a unique natural corridor that unites dozens of countries. France, 2023

programme.title: PHIM TRƯỜNG HOLLYWOOD - HOLLYWOOD ON SET S1

programme.title: ĐỈNH MÙ SƯƠNG - THE FOGGY MOUNTAIN
programme.desc: Phi, một võ sĩ kỳ cựu, bắt đầu một nhiệm vụ trả thù sau khi tội phạm tàn nhẫn BA Rau đã giết vợ mình. Hành trình của anh đưa anh vào ngôi làng xa xôi gần Núi Foggy, nơi anh phát hiện ra các hoạt động buôn người của Ba Rau. Trận đấu cuối cùng là không thể tránh khỏi vì Phi phải hạ gục Ba Rau để cứu dân làng và trả thù cho vợ anh ta chết.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn về bốn người nổi tiếng nam nổi tiếng từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được trả tiền bằng toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho nhóm Bros Bros!

programme.title: DIỄN VIÊN ĐÓNG THẾ VÕ THUẬT - KUNGFU STUNTMEN
programme.desc: Điện ảnh hành động Hồng Kông nổi tiếng với những động thái kung thực sự được thực hiện bởi một nhóm có tên là Kung Kung Fu Stuntmen. Bộ phim Docu này vinh danh các thế hệ đóng thế Kung Fu, với phi hành đoàn dành hơn hai năm để đào lưu tài liệu và phỏng vấn nhiều tài năng, bao gồm cả những bậc thầy nổi bật nhất như Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen và Sammo Hung.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn về bốn người nổi tiếng nam nổi tiếng từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được trả tiền bằng toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho nhóm Bros Bros!

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH 2 - THE GREY MEN 2
programme.desc: Ông trùm Hội Tam Hoàng Song tìm cách xóa sạch hình ảnh của mình và chiếm lấy ghế thị trưởng của Laika trong bối cảnh chế độ thay đổi. Anh ta phải đối mặt với sự thiếu hụt kinh phí mặc dù đã thông đồng với các quan chức, đồng thời được cánh tay phải và người thi hành án của mình phạm tội để tăng cường quỹ và quyền lực của anh ta. Ngay khi Song tin rằng thành công sắp đến thì động lực giữa ba người lại có một bước ngoặt bất ngờ…

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này mang đến những lực lượng đặc biệt tốt nhất từ ​​Iron Squad để thực hiện một thử thách mới - Dodgeball. 26 người chơi sẽ tham gia một cuộc thi khốc liệt, cho đến khi một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao mạnh mẽ và sức mạnh tinh thần được hình thành. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!

Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRỜ CHƠI ĐOẠT MẠNG - ELIMINATION GAME
programme.desc: Hải quân SEAL Rick bị kết án thối rữa trong một nhà tù quân sự cho đến khi anh ta được trao cơ hội để đưa cuộc sống của mình lên hàng và giành được tự do của mình trong một chương trình giết người hoặc bị giết. Rick sẽ phải loại bỏ một số kẻ giết người khét tiếng nhất thế giới trên truyền hình trực tiếp để có được sự tự do và xóa tên của anh ta. Cuối cùng anh ấy có thể thành công không?
